name: UserX
summary: UserX Analytics iOS SDK: session recording, heatmaps and user behavior analytics for mobile apps.
description: UserX Analytics SDK for iOS records user sessions, builds heatmaps and collects behavior analytics for your app. Integrate it into your application to see how users interact with your screens.
